This is a static declaration/no-growth report. A row means the kind
was in a per-family Rust `IMPLEMENTED` registry but was not declared
by any smoke config for the matching `must_cover` axis at the snapshot
base. It does **not** mean the kind never executed, and declaring a row
does **not** prove that a trajectory exercises it.

The binding gate parses the live registries with the coverage-badge
deriver and parses smoke JSON with the differential's own config parser.
Unknown declarations and new debt are red. Old rows may disappear from
the live report only when they gain a declaration; deleting any
baseline IMPLEMENTED row is independently red.

The snapshot also freezes all 319 implemented rows so
a ported mechanic cannot regress to a stub and masquerade as resolved
declaration debt.
